full_judgment: 6. It is true that excepting the informant (P.W.1) other prosecution witnesses including P.W.3 did not support the prosecution case. The informant who is an eye witness to the occurrence as P. W.1 in her evidence corroborated the entire prosecution case as narrated by her in the F.I.R. stating that on the date of occurrence at about 7.00 A.M. in the morning her son All Ashraf was going to the field with bullock. At that time accused Chand Mia intercepted him and rebuked him and also did not allow him to pass with bullock. Accused Chand Mia then raised but and cry and other accused persons including appellants being around with various weapons came to the 'palan' of informant's homestead. The informant and her husband went there and requested the accused to settle the matter in a salish but the accused persons did not listen to them. Then at the order of accused Chand Mia accused Yousuf Bepari gave a 'katra' blow at the left chest of the deceased and the witness pulled out the 'katra' and bandaged the wound. She also stated that accused Chunnu Mia dealt a Raksha blow to P.W.3 Nawab Ali and other accused threw brick-bats at randam causing injury to Ali Ashraf. Thus it is clear from the evidence of the informant that there is no material contradiction in her evidence regarding the time, manner and place of occurrence.
